statusLine.command:
find_root() { d="$1"; while [ "$d" != "/" ] && [ -n "$d" ]; do if [ -d "$d/packages" ] && [ -d "$d/apps" ] && [ -d "$d/frontend" ]; then printf "%s" "$d"; return 0; fi; d=$(dirname "$d"); done; return 1; }
INPUT=$(cat)
START=$(printf '%s' "$INPUT" | jq -r '.cwd // .workspace.current_dir // .workspace.project_dir // empty' 2>/dev/null)
[ -z "$START" ] && START="$PWD"
ROOT=$(find_root "$START")
[ -z "$ROOT" ] && ROOT="$START"
gb() { git -C "$1" branch --show-current 2>/dev/null || echo '?'; }
B=$(gb "$ROOT")
DBENV=$(grep -m1 '^DB_ENV=' "$ROOT/apps/copor/server/.env" 2>/dev/null | cut -d= -f2)
USED_PCT=$(printf '%s' "$INPUT" | jq -r '.context_window.used_percentage // empty' 2>/dev/null)
SIZE=$(printf '%s' "$INPUT" | jq -r '.context_window.context_window_size // empty' 2>/dev/null)
INTOK=$(printf '%s' "$INPUT" | jq -r '.context_window.total_input_tokens // empty' 2>/dev/null)
if [ -n "$SIZE" ] && [ -n "$INTOK" ]; then
  LEFT=$((SIZE - INTOK))
  LEFT_K=$((LEFT / 1000))
  CTX_STR="${USED_PCT:-?}% used, ${LEFT_K}k left"
else
  CTX_STR="warming up"
fi
printf 'branch:%s | DB_ENV:%s | ctx: %s' "$B" "${DBENV:-?}" "$CTX_STR"
